subject: planner: remove IsReadOnly function pointer (#64047)
summary: Change is a refactor: removes `plannercore.IsReadOnly` function-pointer hook and moves the implementation into `pkg/planner/core/util.go` as concrete `IsReadOnly`/`IsReadOnlyInternal`, updating planner/executor/session callers accordingly. Verified the read-only logic is unchanged (including `ExecuteStmt` prepared-stmt unwrap + `checkGlobalVars` behavior) and found no remaining init-order/nil-callback hazard for `IsReadOnly`. No later upstream/master commits indicate a follow-up fix related to this change.
